raw.analysis: <summary>Verifying gcov instrumentation in compiled SQLite binary</summary>
commands:
{"tool_name": "code_run", "args": {"cwd": "/app", "script": "
# Verify gcov instrumentation by checking for gcov-related symbols and files
echo "=== Checking for gcov instrumentation in sqlite3 binary ==="
nm /app/sqlite/bin/sqlite3 | grep -i gcov | head -10

echo -e "\n=== Checking for gcov data files (.gcno) ==="
find /app/sqlite-build/sqlite -name "*.gcno" | head -10

echo -e "\n=== Verifying sqlite3 is accessible from PATH ==="
which sqlite3

echo -e "\n=== Testing sqlite3 functionality ==="
sqlite3 --version

echo -e "\n=== Creating a test database to generate .gcda files ==="
sqlite3 /tmp/test.db "CREATE TABLE test(id INTEGER); INSERT INTO test VALUES(1); SELECT * FROM test;"

echo -e "\n=== Checking for generated .gcda coverage files ==="
find /app/sqlite-build/sqlite -name "*.gcda" -ls | head -5

echo -e "\n=== Installation summary ==="
ls -lh /app/sqlite/bin/sqlite3
ls -lh /app/sqlite/lib/libsqlite3.*
", "type": "bash", "_index": 0, "_tool_num": 1}, "id": "toolu_uWXlfKSXktAA2S90lGdbr1"}
